seo.description: Tank Capacity Calculator — Calculate tank capacity in liters, gallons, barrels, and convert dimensions to standard volume units with instant results & multiple unit support.

formula.explanation: V = π(D/2)² × H. ×1000 converts m³ to liters. For US gallons, divide by 3.785; for barrels divide by 159.

content.introduction: Calculate tank capacity in liters and convert to US gallons (÷3.785), imperial gallons (÷4.546), and oil barrels (÷159). Supports any cylindrical tank.

example.description: 3m × 6m tank = 42,412 L = 11,205 US gal = 9,329 imperial gal = 267 barrels.

faq.q: How do I convert to barrels of oil?
faq.a: 1 barrel = 159 liters = 42 US gallons. Divide liters by 159.

faq.q: What is the difference between US and imperial gallons?
faq.a: 1 US gallon = 3.785 L; 1 imperial (UK) gallon = 4.546 L. US gallons are ~20% smaller.
